title: Can You Swim at the Foot of Cabo Girão?
description: Not a good idea from a boat. The foot of Cabo Girão is a boulder beach under a 580 m cliff that still drops rock, so boats swim at Fajã dos Padres instead.
heroAlt: Boulder beach and fallen rock at the foot of Cabo Girão, seen from the water
keywords: can you swim at Cabo Girão
where to swim near Cabo Girão
is it safe to swim under cliffs in Madeira

images.prompt: Realistic photograph from a boat a few hundred metres offshore, looking at the base of the Cabo Girão cliff in Madeira at mid-morning. A wide beach of grey and brown boulders and pebbles with white surf, a few large fallen blocks, fresh pale scars on the dark rock face above and the cliff rising out of the top of the frame. Deep blue water in the foreground, no swimmers, no boats, natural colours, no text.
images.alt: Boulder beach and fallen rock at the foot of Cabo Girão, seen from the water
